projective_infinity_certificate.lemma: G_infinity(t)=0 makes t a black root; grouping collided labelled roots alpha with total weights A_alpha gives D_infinity=product(x-alpha)^(n_alpha-1) E and E(alpha)=A_alpha*product_{beta!=alpha}(alpha-beta)!=0 for p>29. Therefore ord_t(D_infinity)=4 forces n_t=5; the fixed root 0 then makes every projective coordinate zero.
